paper.title: MemRL: Self-Evolving Agents via Runtime Reinforcement Learning on Episodic Memory
paper.central_claim: MemRL: a frozen LLM agent self-evolves without weight updates by storing Intent-Experience-Utility triplets and learning Q-values over memories from environment rewards, with two-phase retrieval (similarity recall, then Q-aware re-ranking), outperforming RAG/Self-RAG/Mem0/MemP on HLE, BigCodeBench, ALFWorld and Lifelong Agent Bench in both runtime-learning and transfer settings.

gap.author_gap: Fine-tuning costs and forgets; memory/RAG agents retrieve by semantic similarity, so noisy but similar experiences are injected and runtime feedback does not separate high-value strategies from distractors.
gap.checked_gap: 'Similar is not useful' is a real, widely recognised retrieval limitation; the paper builds directly on the M-MDP formulation of Zhou et al. 2025a (retrieval as an MDP action), so the delta is non-parametric, EMA-based utility on stored items rather than the retrieval-as-decision framing itself. That prior is cited but not run as a baseline.
lineage: RAG/Self-RAG -> agentic memory (Reflexion, MemGPT, Mem0, MemP) -> value-aware episodic retrieval (Q-values; Zhou et al. 2025a M-MDP, NEC-style episodic control) -> MemRL
closest_adjacent: Zhou et al. 2025a learned retrieval (cited, not compared)
gap.residue: Credit assignment among co-injected memories, memory growth/consolidation, robustness to wrong rewards, behaviour at low task similarity (author-acknowledged).
gap.stakes: Quality of injected context and forgetting in long deployments.
gap.method_response: Q-values per stored experience updated from rewards and combined with similarity at retrieval.
gap.remaining_gap: Does not address write-side admission, retirement, or poisoned feedback; comparison to learned-retriever neighbours is absent.
unresolved: Delta vs the cited learned-retrieval M-MDP baseline is not measured.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: On OS, DB, BigCodeBench and ALFWorld, a Q-valued episodic memory built on a training split improves held-out-instance success over RAG/MemP with a frozen backbone (author-reported, single 7:3 split/seed); HLE gains are same-question runtime learning.

G.reason: Concrete, sourced limitation (similarity-only retrieval) with the right neighbour families as baselines; delta relative to the cited M-MDP learned-retrieval prior is not run and the remaining-gap boundary is only partly drawn.

M.reason: Retrieval-as-value-decision with a simple EMA, z-scored composite and threshold gating is coherent and fits the stated problem; credit among co-injected memories and the unbaselined utility are acknowledged weak points.

X.reason: Write, recall, rerank, inject and update steps and hyper-parameters are reconstructable; boundaries (low similarity, reward hacking, noise) are stated; no admission/retirement/versioning/rollback and unbounded growth limit retention governance.

E.measurement.reason: Benchmark verifiers/rewards are standard; Pass@10 vs CSR comparison is attempt-matched; HLE grader not described but memorisation is a holdout issue, not a metric-validity one.

E.causality.reason: No-Memory/RAG/MemP baselines, lambda sweep, similarity-gate/normalisation ablation and single-task-feedback ablation isolate utility and cross-task retrieval; lacks alternative utility estimators, write-gate ablation, and multi-seed support, and some ablations are on one benchmark.

E.holdout.reason: Headline Table 1 is the learning stream with labelled rewards; transfer tables use held-out splits but ALFWorld is seen task types, 'best validation' selection is ambiguous, delta/k are set per benchmark, HLE has no held-out split and the authors attribute its gain to memorisation; cross-model HLE transfer likely re-tests seen questions.

E.statistics.reason: Single run per setting, one split seed, no intervals or tests; several margins are 0-6 points and some are ties; negative/neutral results (DB tie, HLE single-task tie) are reported.

E.cost.reason: Token and latency comparison only for HLE vs MemP; memory growth, embedding/LLM summarisation overhead per benchmark and total epochs cost not quantified.
